meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查发布前的代码改动,提前发现遗留问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你发布npm包前想要多智能体全面审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 触发后先运行 /get-unpublished-changes 列出上次 npm 发布以来的改动,按模块分成最多 10 组,并行派 ultrabrain 逐个分析,并调用 /review-work 做整体复核,最后由 1 个 oracle 给出发布就绪度、版本号建议和阻塞问题。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求「发布前审查」时才触发,例如说 “pre-publish review”、“ready to publish?” 等;普通的 publish/release 请求不会触发它,/publish 直接发布。

say.text: 发布前帮我审一下这些改动
say.note: 每个改动组由一个 ultrabrain 分析并给结论

say.text: 我能发布吗?建议升哪个版本号?
say.note: oracle 汇总发布风险与版本号建议

howto.what_en: Runs /get-unpublished-changes to list changes since the last npm release, splits them into up to 10 groups, spawns an ultrabrain agent per group, adds a /review-work pass and one oracle for release readiness, version bump and blocking issues.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. “pre-publish review”, “ready to publish?”. A plain publish/release request does not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review for me.
Review my changes before I publish.
say_en.note: One ultrabrain agent per change group reports verdicts.

say_en.text: Can I publish, and which version bump do you recommend?
say_en.note: The oracle adds release risk and version guidance.
